summary: Completed comprehensive testing of System Observability Module - All 20 backend tests passed (100%), all frontend features verified working correctly

issues: React warning: indicatorClassName prop not recognized on DOM element - minor console warning, doesn't affect functionality

developer_login.details: POST /api/auth/login with dev@me.mx / LastMile2026 returns role=developer, token valid

health_dashboard.details: GET /api/system/health returns api_status, mongo_status, avg_latency_ms, errors_4xx_24h, errors_5xx_24h, upload_size_mb, uptime, recent_errors. UI shows 6 status cards, error timeline, uptime display

performance_metrics.details: GET /api/system/performance returns requests_per_hour, slowest_endpoints, active_users. UI shows bar chart for requests/hour, slowest endpoints list, active users with progress bars

log_viewer.details: GET /api/system/logs returns paginated audit logs with filters. Login events appear as audit entries. GET /api/system/logs/export returns CSV file. UI shows filter bar (date, action type, errors only), paginated table

error_tracker.details: GET /api/system/errors returns system errors. GET /api/system/errors/count returns unreviewed count. POST /api/system/errors/{id}/review marks as reviewed. UI shows error cards with occurrence count, mark-as-reviewed button, badge in sidebar (6 unreviewed)

integrity_checker.details: POST /api/system/integrity/run runs all validation checks and returns issues. GET /api/system/integrity/results returns latest results. UI shows run button, summary cards (Total, Alta, Media, Baja), issues list with severity badges

system_config.details: GET /api/system/config returns backend_version (FastAPI 0.110.1), python_version (3.11.14), mongo_host (localhost:27017), db_name (test_database), jwt_expiry_hours (24), uptime. UI in Settings > System tab shows all config values

sidebar_access_control.details: System section visible for developer and coordinator roles. NOT visible for agent role. Verified via UI testing

api_access_control.details: Agent role correctly receives 403 Forbidden on all /api/system/* endpoints (health, logs, errors, integrity, config)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing test data from previous iterations.
